value.rationale: The rank-two Grassmannian matrix coefficient space is a natural irreducible normed function band for every dimension. The complete sharp L4/L2 interval has a nontrivial spectral optimizer reversal from balanced to one-outlier exactly between n=7 and n=8; the exact spectral deficits quantify this and determine the precise optimal Euclidean Banach–Mazur distance. Unlike a routine low-n numeric moment, it is a uniform structural result across all dimensions.
